children: Surgery Partners received the required consents to amend its subsidiary’s $1,225.0M of 7.250% notes due 2032, adding BSMH-related parties as permitted holders if the merger closes. Consenting holders are expected to receive $5.00 per $1,000 of principal on Nov. 24, whether or not the merger closes.
Requisite consents received for note amendments
Clears the consent threshold for amendments that accommodate the proposed merger, but the amendments become operative only if the merger closes.
The consent fee is a cash cost to the issuer; payment is expected Nov. 24 even if the merger does not close.
The debt terms otherwise remain unchanged; no prior-period comparison applies to this transaction amount.

This is a transaction-enabling step in Surgery Partners’ previously announced proposed merger, rather than a new operating or financial trend. The next catalysts are execution of the supplemental indenture, expected around Nov. 24, and satisfaction of conditions for the merger to close.
from Surgery Partners, Inc. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
